Teachers Report Overwork and Stress Due to Election Duty

Teachers in Delhi and Mumbai are reporting extreme working hours and a lack of rest due to their duties related to the upcoming elections, referred to as 'SIR duty'. In Delhi, teachers claim to be working 11-hour days with no rest, leading to burnout. Mumbai schools are also facing a crisis, with teachers questioning the impact on children's education when they are assigned these election-related tasks.
